payload.summary: check:offline-pack is not run by CI or any verify gate, so the offline page can silently fall behind signed-off timeline deadlines
payload.detail: public/offline.html is generated by scripts/build-offline-pack.ts from WA_CRISIS_CONTACTS and reviewed mha-timeframes entries. After a sign-off it silently omits the new entry (safe direction) until someone rebuilds it and bumps CACHE_VERSION. Wire check:offline-pack into static-pr / verify:pr-local, or make the sign-off tool rebuild the pack.
